_readme: Albums go into galleryAlbums and videos into videos, both in src/data/media.ts.
Album images keep their own aspect ratio in the masonry grid, so supply real
width and height values — that is what prevents layout shift.
YouTube entries need only the video id: the poster and the privacy-enhanced
embed URL are derived, and the iframe only mounts after the viewer presses play.

album.title: REQUIRED
album.category: leadership | campaign | events | community | government | congress | other

video.title: REQUIRED
video.category: campaign | interviews | events | speeches | documentary | activities

embed.ref: REQUIRED — YouTube/Vimeo id, or an absolute URL when provider is "file"
